datasets.title: Nepal - Allocation of Relief Material in earthquake affected districts
datasets.description: This datasets contain list of all food and non food items which are allocated and sent as relief material to affected districts due to earthquake. It was recorded by Nepal Disaster Risk Reduction Portal. Link : http://drrportal.gov.np/. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/allocation-of-relief-material-in-earthquake-affected-districts]

lineage.description: Relief material allocation records were compiled by the Nepal Disaster Risk Reduction Portal following the earthquake event. The dataset documents food and non-food items committed and sent to affected districts, representing post-event humanitarian response and recovery operations.

sources.name: Nepal Disaster Risk Reduction Portal
sources.description: Administrative records of relief material (food and non-food items) allocated and distributed to earthquake-affected districts by the Government of Nepal.
